Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. I can't offer the request exactly as written, for the reasons below.

**What we looked at:** the Studio (up to 12 people, 4 hours) with a coffee break for each of your 10 attendees:



| Item | Detail | Price |
|---|---|---:|
| Studio (V1) | 4 hours | €240 |
| Coffee break (S1) | 10 people x €8 | €80 |
| **Total** | | **€320** |
| Budget | | €300 |
| Difference | | €20 over budget |



**Why this doesn't work as specified:** the total for this package is over your budget.

- **Loyalty price reduction:** a loyalty reduction is not something BrightRoom offers. Our listed prices are fixed, so I can't apply any reduction.
- **"Same as last year":** I don't have the details of last year's booking, so I've only priced what you wrote in this message. Please tell me if last year's event included anything else.
- **Accessibility:** you didn't mention it, so I've assumed nobody needs wheelchair access. The Studio can only be reached by stairs. If anyone needs a route without stairs, please tell me, because the Studio would not suit.

**Options you could consider.** Each one needs your agreement, and each gives something up:



| Option | Package | People | Total | What the client gives up |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Studio + Coffee break | 10 | €320 | budget raised from €300 to €320 (+€20) |
| 2 | Studio + Coffee break | 7 | €296 | headcount reduced from 10 to at most 7 |
| 3 | Studio | 10 | €240 | Coffee break (a stated requirement) is removed |

Every option changes a stated requirement and needs the client's explicit consent.



- Option 1 keeps the Studio and the coffee break for 10 people, but you would have to raise your budget.
- Option 2 keeps the Studio and the coffee break within your budget, but the group would be reduced to at most 7 people.
- Option 3 keeps 10 people in the Studio, but the coffee break is dropped.

Dates also need a separate availability check. Nothing is held for you at this stage.

Please let me know which direction you'd prefer, or get in touch with any questions.

Kind regards
